evidence.label: EXPLAIN
evidence.quote: Now let me make this normal folder into a git repository. To do that what we have to do? You have to type git init.

evidence.label: DEMONSTRATE
evidence.quote: I will simply type git --version. And when I type enter you can see this is the latest version of your git.

evidence.label: STUDENT_INTERACT
evidence.quote: To do that what we have to do? You have to type git init.

evidence.label: REINFORCE
evidence.quote: Now when I type git status you can see that a.ext now is in green color. That means it is telling you that the changes are ready to be committed.

evidence.label: PREDICT_CHANGE
evidence.quote: When you type git reset. All the changes will be reverted back.
